# #9801 slice 1: every prototype test this slice ports, by Python name.
# tests/ported_names.rs fails when one has no Rust test of the same name
# preceded by a `// Python: <name>` line. Source: the Architect prototype's
# scripts/test_usage.py at 0d1ef3b (usage.py unchanged since 76a5a12).
#
# Not ported, and why:
# - test_parse_usage_capture_sample, test_parse_usage_capture_model_block_and_garbage,
#   test_time_only_reset_rolls_to_next_day: parse_usage_capture/parse_reset serve
#   `usage.py ingest`, which usage-probe.sh runs; the poller never calls them.
# - test_statusline_tee_caches_and_passes_through: statusline-tee.sh, a shell hook.
# - test_usage_probe_types_reads_escapes_and_ingests,
#   test_usage_probe_never_types_over_a_draft_or_a_running_turn: usage-probe.sh,
#   which the port launches unchanged.
# - The format_plan assertion inside test_plan_names_best_next_account_and_skips_exhausted_5h:
#   format_plan is the `usage.py plan` CLI text, not poller output.
